verdict.rationale: CIPO's own patents page publishes a 'Find a licensed patent agent' entry, which points to an office-sanctioned representative rail through which a licensed professional can act for an applicant. The evidence is only a link title, so the mechanics behind it are unevidenced. Missing for 10: documentation of how an agent is appointed or authorized to act for a company, trademark-agent equivalents, account-level delegation within MyCIPO, scope and revocation of representation, and independent corroboration.
